title: Chazal 1985 thoracic ALL stress-strain characteristic points A, B, C (mean of specimens)

quantity.name: stress-strain curve points
quantity.definition: stress = force / smallest CSA (MPa) vs strain = elongation / resting length between nearest bony insertions (%), at A (end of toe), B (end of linear region), C (apex/rupture); mean of per-specimen Table 3 values computed by the extractor

source.authors: Chazal J, Tanguy A, Bourges M, Gaurel G, Escande G, Guillot M, Vanneuville G
source.sample: 43 whole ligaments from 18 spines (34 from 12 fresh cadavers <24 h post mortem, 30-80 y, mean 53; 9 SSL/ISL from living surgical subjects); human whole spinal ligaments (ALL, PLL, LF, ISL+SSL, ITL), cervical to lumbar; bone clamped

protocol.summary: Uniaxial tension of entire ligaments, bones held in custom clamps (never the ligament or its insertions), universal joints; constant rate 1 mm/min for loading and relaxation; cadaver ligaments kept in water/alcohol/glycerin solution, surgical ligaments in Ringer and tested <1 h. CSA measured every 2 mm with a palpator, smallest value used for stress; length between nearest bony insertions. Curves sigmoid: point A = end of initial toe (concave) region, point B = end of linear region, point C = apex (rupture).
how_to_simulate: Model the ligament between its bony insertions at the reported resting length and CSA (rows give length_mm, csa_mm2)
Apply uniaxial elongation along the fibres at a quasi-static rate (1 mm/min) to rupture
Report nominal stress (force / CSA) at the listed strains (elongation / resting length)

data.note: mean of specimens above (computed by extractor); x_sd = SD of strain (%)

extraction.uncertainty: as printed; means derived by extractor
extraction.check_notes: Read from 250-dpi renders of the rotated Table 3; consistent with the existing chazal1985 point-C tests (failure force/elongation/strain means reproduced). Points A/B missing for some surgical ISL+SSL specimens (not printed), so n differs per point. Cervical and C7-T1 rows excluded; T12-L1 counted as lumbar (as in the existing tests). Printed strain disagrees with dl/l for: T6-T7 (cadaver, 55 y) point B: printed strain 0.5 vs dl/l = 3.2/6 = 0.53 (printed value kept).

pass_rule.rule: model curve passes within 1 SD of the mean point (both axes) at A, B and C
